_readme: Plant office study, three floors. Source deck exports are NOT committed (public repo).
One client mark only: an emblem on the reception back wall. Everything else is unmarked.
Title-card slides and the duplicate reception view are excluded, not redacted.

open-plan-workstations.alt: Open-plan office workstations in a long bay with glazed cabins along one side
open-plan-workstations.caption: The workstation bay, with cabins glazed to the floor so daylight carries across. Indicative viewpoint.

reception-desk.note: DROPPED. A large client emblem sits centred on the reception back wall, directly behind the desk. Patching it leaves a visible rectangle against the wall's gradient, and the second reception view (p06) carries the same mark. Both are excluded rather than badly retouched — there are eleven unmarked views without them. Revisit only if the deck's source render can be re-exported without the emblem.

guest-waiting-lounge.alt: Visitor waiting lounge with armchairs, a sofa and a timber slat ceiling
guest-waiting-lounge.caption: Guest waiting, placed inside the gate but outside the working floor. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room-ground-floor.alt: Ten-seat meeting room with a wall-mounted screen and graphic accent wall
meeting-room-ground-floor.caption: The ground-floor meeting room, reachable without crossing the office. Indicative viewpoint.

dispatch-office.alt: Dispatch office workstations facing a window onto the yard with a graphic wall behind
dispatch-office.caption: Dispatch, kept at ground level with a view of the yard it coordinates. Indicative viewpoint.

conference-room.alt: Sixteen-seat conference room with a timber-panelled screen wall and glazing to one side
conference-room.caption: The conference room, sized for full management reviews. Indicative viewpoint.

discussion-room.alt: Eight-seat discussion room with a ring pendant light and blinds on the window wall
discussion-room.caption: A discussion room for the meetings that do not need the conference table. Indicative viewpoint.

war-room.alt: Small war room with a six-seat table, screen and window blinds
war-room.caption: The war room: a standing daily review space, deliberately small. Indicative viewpoint.

plant-head-cabin.alt: Plant head's cabin with a meeting table for six and glazing to the plant side
plant-head-cabin.caption: Plant head's cabin, with its own table so reviews happen in the room. Indicative viewpoint.

director-cabin.alt: Director's cabin with a desk, three visitor chairs and a display unit behind
director-cabin.caption: Director's cabin, on the management floor above the visitor route. Indicative viewpoint.

staff-canteen.alt: Staff canteen with long tables, bench seating and pendant lights over a glazed wall
staff-canteen.caption: The canteen, on the top floor away from both production and meetings. Indicative viewpoint.

training-room.alt: Training room laid out in rows of chairs facing a presenter's desk
training-room.caption: Training room, laid out for induction and compliance sessions. Indicative viewpoint.

breakout-area.alt: Breakout area with a table tennis table, cafe seating and a graphic feature wall
breakout-area.caption: Breakout beside the canteen, so the amenity floor works through the day. Indicative viewpoint.
